why_ai: Adversarial, novel probing of models; demand grows with AI though automated suites take the breadth work.
why_clarity: Coverage is unmeasurable, so a clean report cannot be checked against any agreed standard.
why_digital: Models are probed, findings recorded and reports delivered entirely online to remote clients.

why_ai: Proprietary cross-model failure corpus gains value as AI spreads; analysis itself is largely automatable.
why_clarity: Structured probe-defence-outcome records support repeatable analysis, but which defences work stays debatable.
why_digital: Inputs are recorded assessments and outputs are published evidence, all digital.

why_ai: Re-running a recorded assessment on a new model version is mechanical and software-native.
why_clarity: Each finding either reproduces on the new version or not, across every routine upgrade.
why_digital: Recorded probes rerun against hosted models with results delivered as digital reports.

why_ai: Expert engagements sell novel judgement while tooling half is breadth that automation already covers.
why_clarity: Automated breadth is checkable but expert findings vary by researcher and coverage stays undefined.
why_digital: Assessments of deployed models run and deliver entirely on screens to remote buyers.

why_ai: Catalogue of known techniques run continuously; a public dataset and scripting already compete.
why_clarity: Known probes rerun across many systems with pass or fail outcomes per technique.
why_digital: Pure software product sold to engineering teams and run against hosted models.

why_ai: No method exists yet; defining risk-surface coverage is an open, consequential research problem.
why_clarity: No agreed method or standard exists for what fraction of an unbounded input space was tested.
why_digital: Measurement is built over model inputs and assessment logs, delivered as digital evidence.

why_ai: Eliciting what goes wrong in clinical or financial deployments needs domain experts and contextual judgement.
why_clarity: Each regulated domain needs a fresh elicitation and completeness of a taxonomy is hard to verify.
why_digital: Built from expert interviews and documents, delivered as digital taxonomies to regulated buyers.

why_ai: Clients pay for the novel finding their own team and automated suites missed.
why_clarity: Each expert attacks differently by feel; a finding reproduces but absence of findings proves nothing.
why_digital: Researchers probe hosted models remotely and deliver findings as confidential digital reports.

why_ai: Once a rubric exists, scoring findings against it is mechanical and automatable.
why_clarity: Contextual harm severity has no shared framework, so two parties rate the same finding differently.
why_digital: Findings lists are scored and disputed entirely as digital records.

why_ai: Exposure can be filtered by tooling but sustaining scarce researchers needs human support and duty of care.
why_clarity: Harm from sustained exposure shows up as attrition months or years later, with no agreed measure.
why_digital: Exposure tooling is digital, but wellbeing support and rotation involve in-person care.

why_ai: Translating recorded findings into engineering and compliance documents is exactly what LLMs do well.
why_clarity: Two standard document types per engagement, checkable against the recorded findings.
why_digital: Findings in, documents out, all produced and delivered on screen.
